summary: Iteration 3 frontend testing for the four new features: Workout Logging, AI Activity Feed with Undo, Receipt Scan Review, Progress Photos. All four flows work end-to-end after one small backend fix (AIChatBody.message made Optional so /api/ai/receipt no longer 422s when only image_base64 is sent). Regression on Money/Groceries/People/Tasks/Nutrition/Home pages: all load without errors.

minor.issue: AIChatBody required `message: str`, so the receipt-scan payload {image_base64:...} returned 422 Unprocessable Entity and the review dialog never opened. FIXED by making `message` Optional[str] = ''. Retested and dialog opens correctly.

Gemini prompt says 'NEVER invent prices' but on a blank / unreadable image it still hallucinated a plausible merchant ('WHOLE FOODS MARKET') and five item lines with prices. Not blocking (user reviews before saving) but the guardrail is not effective — consider adding a confidence check or a 'no items detected' path.

action_items: Review the AIChatBody change — `message` is now Optional; /api/ai/chat still receives a message from the UI so no regression expected, but confirm.
Harden the /api/ai/receipt prompt or post-process to drop hallucinated items when the image is not actually a receipt (e.g. accept an empty items[] instead of inventing WHOLE FOODS lines).
critical_code_review_comments: AIChatBody is reused for /ai/chat, /ai/receipt and elsewhere but the required fields differ per endpoint; better to split into ChatBody vs ReceiptBody to keep contracts explicit.

photoSrc() in Body.jsx embeds the JWT in the URL query string (?auth=). Works and matches backend, but tokens end up in browser history / server access logs — consider using Authorization header via a signed proxy or short-lived signed URLs.

Fitness LogDialog: pressing Save with the default template creates a session with zero editing — good UX for quick log, but there is no explicit 'Save' confirmation state and no validation (e.g. all zero sets are still saved).
server.py continues to grow (>1830 lines now); splitting into routers is overdue.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 fitness sessions (1 default Push, 1 AI-logged Pull with dead hang 50s -> new PR), 1 AI-created task 'buy protein' which was then Undone via Activity, 2 progress photos (one deleted, one left as fixture), 1 expense from receipt scan (TEST_ReceiptShop_v2 with TestItem €3.50). Leftover data is minimal and prefixed TEST_ where relevant.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Container date 2026-09-28. All 4 iteration-3 features verified via Playwright: log-workout-btn -> workout-log-dialog -> workout-save flow works; AI 'Log a Pull workout: pull-ups 3 sets of 9, dead hang 50 seconds' produces a new history row and updates dead-hang PR to 50s; ai-tab-activity lists entries with undo-<id> buttons and 'Undone' state after click; receipt scan requires backend fix (now in place) then opens receipt-review with editable fields and receipt-save creates a transaction; progress photos upload (photo-upload-btn), render via ?auth=<token>, allow selecting two for compare-view, and photo-del-<id> removes them. All regressed pages loaded without visible error elements.
rca of the issue: Receipt scan dialog never opened because /api/ai/receipt returned 422. Root cause: FastAPI Pydantic model AIChatBody declared `message: str` (required), while ReceiptReview flow only sends {image_base64}. Fix: make `message` Optional with default empty string. Verified end-to-end after fix.
